text:
Mika: Quick thought — proposal to add predicate-based safety checks for runtime flags. idea: every flag can declare a small set of "safe predicates" that, if violated by telemetry, automatically shift traffic to fallback.
Sanjay: Can you sketch a minimal schema? how do we express predicates + fallback?
Mika: Minimal example below:
```json
{"flag_name":"route_by_cost","predicate":{"metric":"error_rate","window_s":"300","threshold":0.02,"operator":"gt"},"fallback":{"action":"route_to_variant","variant":"stable","max_qps":500}}
```
Olivia: Nice. Two comments: 1) need a TTL on predicates so stale automatic rollbacks don't keep firing. 2) we need an admin-visible reason in audit logs when fallback triggers.
Jamal: UX: Console should show active predicate hits and a one-click rollback/ack button. Also show recent samples that tripped the predicate.
Sanjay: Implementation question: where evaluate predicates? control-plane or runtime? control-plane easier for visibility but adds latency to decision loop.
Mika: Plan A: evaluate in control-plane with cached metrics (1s scrape) and push decision to runtime via config delta. Plan B: runtime-local evaluation for low-latency signals (cpu/memory). Which signals fall in which bucket?
Olivia: We should classify signals: central (error_rate, p95 latency) -> control-plane. host-local (GPU mem, pod restarts) -> runtime. Keep interface identical for users.
Jamal: Safety knobs: 1) kill-switch checkbox on flag that overrides predicate evaluation 2) deadman-timer: after fallback triggers, auto-alert and require human ack after X minutes.
Mika: Agreed. Also add a sampling quota so predicate triggers only on a weighted sample for noisy signals to avoid flapping. Suggest default sample=0.2.
Sanjay: Telemetry: need a standardized schema for events when predicate evaluates true: {flag, predicate_id, signal, value, window, action_taken, reason, triggered_by}. That allows dashboards + alerts.
Olivia: For dashboards: per-flag timeline, stacked bars for predicate hits, one-liner for current effective config, and link to last payload that caused fallback.
Jamal: Security: ensure predicate evaluation decisions can be audited and that rollback requires role-based permission. cc @security-bot for policy check.
security-bot: Flag policy note: automatic fallback ok, but mutating infra/config must be logged to audit trail and require at minimum ops-reviewer role for permanent overrides.
Mika: Implementation tasks: - schema PR (control-plane config proto) - console wireframes for predicate UI - runtime delta path for fallback + ack endpoint - telemetry event contract - RBAC check in console. Volunteers?
Sanjay: I'll take the control-plane proto + runtime delta.
Olivia: I'll do wireframes and dashboard mockups.
Jamal: I'll do telemetry schema + alert playbook.
Mika: Timeline: prototype in 2 weeks, canary 1:100 traffic, then 1:10, then 1:1. Metrics to gate: error_rate, p95, and request_failure_count.
Sanjay: One more caveat: make sure predicates can't be used to escalate routing to cheaper models without additional approvals (cost-avoidance exploit). add a "cost-affecting" flag on predicates that triggers finance review.
Mika: Good call. Add "affects_billing":true/false field.
Jamal: Example final config we can use for the prototype: 
```json
{
  "flag_name":"route_by_cost",
  "predicates":[
    {"id":"p1","metric":"error_rate","window_s":120,"threshold":0.03,"operator":"gt","sample":0.2,"affects_billing":false},
    {"id":"p2","metric":"p95_latency_ms","window_s":300,"threshold":1200,"operator":"gt","sample":1.0,"affects_billing":false}
  ],
  "fallback":{"action":"route_to_variant","variant":"stable"},
  "deadman_timer_s":600
}
```
Mika: Perfect. I'll open the RFC draft and link to this thread. please drop comments there. :thumbsup:
Olivia: Quick question on metrics ingestion — should we rely on existing metrics API or add a low-latency streaming path for critical signals?
Sanjay: Start with existing metrics API (Prom/TSDB) for prototype. if we need <1s fidelity we'll add stream later.
Jamal: I'll add alert templates for oncall.
Mika: Thanks all. tagging for review: @Sanjay @Olivia @Jamal.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: config-service/pr-789 -> staging.
Mika: will follow up with RFC link in ~30m.
